meta.title: AI Security Research Graph - Research Seed
meta.research_disclosure: Primary-source pages and abstracts were checked; no experiments were reproduced, and listed videos were not watched. Source-linked does not mean all primary papers were reviewed in full.

adapt-abliteration.title: Refusal-direction ablation / abliteration
adapt-abliteration.summary: Refusal-related interventions may use activation ablation or derived weight edits; narrower than removing every safeguard.

adapt-controlnet.title: ControlNet-style conditioning
adapt-controlnet.summary: Add structured conditioning pathways to a generative pipeline.

adapt-distillation.title: Knowledge distillation
adapt-distillation.summary: Teacher-student transfer can be authorized development or support unauthorized functional imitation.

adapt-dreambooth.title: DreamBooth personalization
adapt-dreambooth.summary: Subject-specific diffusion fine-tuning; neutral personalization technique.

adapt-full.title: Full-parameter fine-tuning
adapt-full.summary: Update most or all model weights for a new objective; neutral adaptation.

adapt-lora.title: LoRA
adapt-lora.summary: Train low-rank update matrices; malicious behavior depends on data, objective and deployment.

adapt-model-edit.title: Targeted model editing
adapt-model-edit.summary: Modify selected learned associations; locality and side effects require evaluation.

adapt-peft.title: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning
adapt-peft.summary: Adapt a subset or added parameters rather than all model weights.

adapt-prefix.title: Prefix tuning
adapt-prefix.summary: Learn continuous prefixes while freezing base parameters.

adapt-qlora.title: QLoRA
adapt-qlora.summary: Combine quantized base weights with low-rank adaptation; neither a model format nor an attack.

adapt-representation.title: Representation engineering
adapt-representation.summary: Analyze or modify internal representations; neutral methodological umbrella.

adapt-softprompt.title: Soft prompt tuning
adapt-softprompt.summary: Learn prompt embeddings rather than authoring ordinary discrete text prompts.

adapt-steering.title: Activation steering
adapt-steering.summary: Change runtime representations using a chosen intervention and appropriate activation access.

adapt-textual-inversion.title: Textual inversion
adapt-textual-inversion.summary: Learned concept embeddings for generation; not the same concept as privacy model inversion.

adapt-unlearning.title: Machine unlearning and concept erasure
adapt-unlearning.summary: Attempts to remove learned influence or concepts require explicit success definitions and adversarial evaluation.

arch-classical.title: Classical predictive ML
arch-classical.summary: Classifiers, regressors, trees and ensembles form an essential baseline beyond LLMs.

arch-cnn.title: Convolutional networks
arch-cnn.summary: Image-oriented convolutional architectures with spatial feature extraction.

arch-decoder.title: Decoder-only autoregressive language models
arch-decoder.summary: Generate token sequences conditioned on preceding context; distinguish base and instruction-tuned checkpoints.

arch-diffusion.title: Diffusion generative models
arch-diffusion.summary: Generative processes learned through noise-related denoising objectives, not a single backbone architecture.

arch-dit.title: Diffusion transformers
arch-dit.summary: Transformer backbones used for diffusion; not equivalent to autoregressive language modeling.

arch-embedding.title: Embedding and reranking models
arch-embedding.summary: Representations and scoring models supporting retrieval and similarity workflows.

arch-encdec.title: Encoder-decoder models
arch-encdec.summary: Separate source encoding and conditional sequence decoding.

arch-encoder.title: Encoder-only language models
arch-encoder.summary: Bidirectional encoders used in representation learning and discriminative tasks.

arch-flow.title: Flow-matching generative models
arch-flow.summary: Related continuous generative modeling objectives requiring their own objective and sampler labels.

arch-gan.title: Generative adversarial networks
arch-gan.summary: Generator-discriminator training; the word adversarial here does not imply malicious use.

arch-latent-diffusion.title: Latent diffusion pipelines
arch-latent-diffusion.summary: Diffusion operates in a learned latent space, with separate encoding and decoding components.

arch-moe.title: Mixture-of-experts models
arch-moe.summary: Sparse expert routing is a component choice that can coexist with transformer backbones.

arch-neural.title: Neural networks
arch-neural.summary: Parameterized differentiable models; a shared prerequisite, not a specific generative family.

arch-ssm.title: State-space and hybrid sequence models
arch-ssm.summary: Alternative or hybrid sequence computation; transformer-specific edits do not transfer automatically.

arch-transformer.title: Transformers
arch-transformer.summary: Attention-based blocks used in multiple modeling objectives and modalities.

arch-unet.title: U-Net-style diffusion backbones
arch-unet.summary: Convolutional multiscale denoisers often used within image diffusion pipelines.

arch-vae.title: Variational autoencoders
arch-vae.summary: Latent-variable encoders and decoders; can also be components of larger generative pipelines.

arch-vlm.title: Vision-language models
arch-vlm.summary: Coupled visual representations and language processing introduce multiple input pathways.

attack-adapter-tamper.title: Malicious adapters or adapter substitution
attack-adapter-tamper.summary: Distribute or apply an attacker-controlled adaptation artifact to alter behavior.
attack-adapter-tamper.caveat: Adapter format alone does not establish a backdoor; this is a composed threat scenario needing artifact-specific evidence.

attack-agent-loop.title: Tool-loop and recursive-delegation exhaustion
attack-agent-loop.summary: Induce repeated actions or delegated calls when agent execution lacks effective budgets.
attack-agent-loop.caveat: Model reasoning, tool cost and wall-clock limits require separate accounting.

attack-artifact-substitution.title: Artifact, adapter or configuration substitution
attack-artifact-substitution.summary: Replace a trusted distribution object with an unreviewed version or misleading identity.
attack-artifact-substitution.caveat: A hash provides integrity only relative to a trusted expected value and provenance.

attack-attribute.title: Model inversion and attribute inference
attack-attribute.summary: Infer sensitive attributes or input-related information from model behavior and auxiliary knowledge.
attack-attribute.caveat: Attribute inference, prototype reconstruction and exact example extraction are different outcomes.

attack-backdoor.title: Trigger-conditioned model backdoors
attack-backdoor.summary: Implant attacker-selected behavior activated by a trigger while retaining ordinary utility.
attack-backdoor.caveat: Record trigger, target behavior, clean utility and attack success separately.

attack-cache-sidechannel.title: Prompt-cache timing inference
attack-cache-sidechannel.summary: Use observable service timing to investigate shared caching or prior prompt use.
attack-cache-sidechannel.caveat: Cache sharing and a statistically usable signal must be demonstrated, not assumed.

attack-capability-abuse.title: AI-assisted harmful activity
attack-capability-abuse.summary: Use generation, analysis or automation for harmful purposes without necessarily breaking the model.
attack-capability-abuse.caveat: Describe the risk category without shipping operational harmful payloads or unauthorized target automation.

attack-citation-launder.title: Evidence and citation laundering
attack-citation-launder.summary: Make untrustworthy content appear authoritative through generated references or retrieval chains.
attack-citation-launder.caveat: Editorial scenario, not an automatically established empirical attack for every citation system.

attack-confused-deputy.title: Agent or connector confused-deputy abuse
attack-confused-deputy.summary: Induce a more-privileged component to exercise authority for an unauthorized requester.
attack-confused-deputy.caveat: Protocol authentication and semantic action authorization are separate checks.

attack-dependency.title: Malicious dependencies or repository code
attack-dependency.summary: Compromise the application through imported code, plugins or build dependencies.
attack-dependency.caveat: Traditional software supply-chain controls remain necessary around AI artifacts.

attack-detector-evasion.title: Evasion of an ML security detector
attack-detector-evasion.summary: Modify an input to avoid a specific classifier or deployed detector.
attack-detector-evasion.caveat: Specify the detector and evasion metric; do not infer operational malware evasion from a generic image experiment.

attack-diffusion-backdoor.title: Diffusion backdoors / BadDiffusion
attack-diffusion-backdoor.summary: Alter training or diffusion processes to produce attacker-chosen outcomes under a trigger.
attack-diffusion-backdoor.caveat: Sampler and process-specific assumptions must be retained; no automatic applicability to every flow or DiT model.

attack-diffusion-extraction.title: Diffusion training-image extraction
attack-diffusion-extraction.summary: Recover or closely reproduce training images under the conditions studied in extraction research.
attack-diffusion-extraction.caveat: Specify similarity thresholds, reference corpus and deduplication; do not substitute intuition for evidence.

observations.target_label: Diffusion models evaluated by the paper
observations.claim: Reported training-image extraction under the paper's evaluation conditions.
observations.limitations: No universal success rate or applicability claim for all diffusion and flow models.

attack-direct-injection.title: Direct prompt injection
attack-direct-injection.summary: Attacker-supplied instructions attempt to override application task or trust policy.
attack-direct-injection.caveat: Direct access does not imply control over privileged system messages.

attack-distillation-theft.title: Unauthorized teacher-student capability transfer
attack-distillation-theft.summary: Apply distillation or imitation to acquire capabilities without required permission.
attack-distillation-theft.caveat: Distillation is neutral; the adversarial label depends on authorization and use, not the algorithm name.

attack-eval-contamination.title: Benchmark or evaluation contamination
attack-eval-contamination.summary: Influence measurement by leaking evaluation material into training or changing the evaluation set.
attack-eval-contamination.caveat: Benign overlap, deliberate contamination and judge manipulation are separate phenomena.

attack-excessive-agency.title: Exploitation of excessive delegated agency
attack-excessive-agency.summary: Turn broadly granted tools or missing approvals into unauthorized actions.
attack-excessive-agency.caveat: Excessive agency is an enabling weakness; the attacking mechanism must still be identified.

attack-factual-edit.title: Unauthorized factual model editing
attack-factual-edit.summary: Modify selected model associations to influence later answers.
attack-factual-edit.caveat: ROME is neutral research; unauthorized application is the threat scenario and needs separate authorization context.

attack-fgsm.title: Gradient-based adversarial perturbations / FGSM
attack-fgsm.summary: Use input gradients to find perturbations that affect predictions.
attack-fgsm.caveat: Specify perturbation set, preprocessing and target task.

attack-gcg.title: Gradient-guided adversarial suffixes
attack-gcg.summary: Optimize discrete prompt suffixes through model or surrogate gradient information.
attack-gcg.caveat: White-box construction must not be mislabeled as purely black-box discovery.

attack-gradient-leak.title: Reconstruction from gradients or updates
attack-gradient-leak.summary: Recover information about training inputs from exposed gradients or model updates.
attack-gradient-leak.caveat: Requires update visibility; ordinary text API access does not supply it.

attack-indirect-injection.title: Indirect prompt injection
attack-indirect-injection.summary: Lower-trust documents or tool content carry instructions that an application treats as authority.
attack-indirect-injection.caveat: The external content must be ingested and affect a privileged workflow.

attack-jailbreak.title: Jailbreaking and refusal bypass
attack-jailbreak.summary: Elicit behavior outside an operator's intended model behavior constraints.
attack-jailbreak.caveat: Not every prompt injection is a jailbreak and not every jailbreak exposes confidential data.

attack-judge-manipulation.title: Automated judge or grader manipulation
attack-judge-manipulation.summary: Influence grading instructions, context or feedback so a system appears more successful or safe.
attack-judge-manipulation.caveat: Coverage scenario; needs judge-specific validation before publishing an empirical success claim.

attack-many-shot.title: Many-shot context attacks
attack-many-shot.summary: Use long sequences of demonstrations to steer behavior in the studied long-context setting.
attack-many-shot.caveat: Context capacity, sampling and target version materially affect results.

attack-membership.title: Membership inference
attack-membership.summary: Estimate whether a candidate record was included in a model's training set.
attack-membership.caveat: Requires a meaningful candidate and baseline; membership inference is not full-record reconstruction.

attack-memory-poison.title: Persistent agent-memory poisoning
attack-memory-poison.summary: Plant or induce stored entries that redirect future tasks or decisions.
attack-memory-poison.caveat: Persistence must be tested across sessions; an instruction in one prompt is not sufficient evidence.

attack-merge-tamper.title: Behavioral tampering through merges or conversion
attack-merge-tamper.summary: Introduce an untrusted component or update while transforming a model artifact.
attack-merge-tamper.caveat: A composite scenario, not evidence that ordinary merging or quantization is intrinsically malicious.

attack-model-imitation.title: Black-box functional model extraction
attack-model-imitation.summary: Train a substitute to imitate target behavior from queried outputs.
attack-model-imitation.caveat: Functional fidelity is not equality of weights; query rights and licensing are separate policy questions.

attack-multiagent.title: Inter-agent trust and message manipulation
attack-multiagent.summary: Influence delegated workflows through messages treated as instructions or trusted results.
attack-multiagent.caveat: Composed threat scenario; a multi-agent framework paper is architecture background, not attack proof.

attack-multimodal-injection.title: Instructions carried through multimodal content
attack-multimodal-injection.summary: Lower-trust visible text or interpreted media can become instructions in a multimodal workflow.
attack-multimodal-injection.caveat: This is a scope-level extension; a visual adversarial perturbation is a separate mechanism.

attack-output-sink.title: Improper handling of model-generated output
attack-output-sink.summary: A downstream application treats model output as executable or privileged input without appropriate validation.
attack-output-sink.caveat: The unsafe sink is an application vulnerability; a model need not be specially trained or jailbroken.

attack-pgd.title: Iterative projected adversarial optimization
attack-pgd.summary: Evaluate robustness with iterative constrained perturbation search.
attack-pgd.caveat: A weak attack or gradient masking can falsely suggest robustness.

attack-physical.title: Physical-world adversarial examples
attack-physical.summary: Study perturbations after printing, capture or other real-world transformations.
attack-physical.caveat: Digital success does not imply physical success; transformations are part of the threat model.

attack-preference-poison.title: Preference or reward-signal manipulation
attack-preference-poison.summary: Influence comparisons, reward models or feedback used in post-training.
attack-preference-poison.caveat: Coverage node grounded in threat modeling; not a named-paper claim that all DPO systems are vulnerable.

attack-pretrain-poison.title: Pretraining data poisoning
attack-pretrain-poison.summary: Influence learned behavior by contributing or changing data before broad training.
attack-pretrain-poison.caveat: Effective influence depends on ingestion, filtering, mixture weights and training dynamics.

attack-projection-theft.title: Partial parameter recovery from API behavior
attack-projection-theft.summary: Recover a model projection component or dimensions under specific query and score assumptions.
attack-projection-theft.caveat: Partial projection recovery is not complete recovery of a production model.

observations.claim: Reported partial projection-layer recovery under specific API capabilities.
observations.limitations: Historical study, not a statement about current API vulnerability or complete model-weight recovery.

attack-prompt-leak.title: System or developer prompt disclosure
attack-prompt-leak.summary: Attempt to disclose hidden configuration text supplied to the model.
attack-prompt-leak.caveat: Disclosure alone is not proof of a security compromise; secrets should not rely on prompt secrecy.

attack-rag-disclosure.title: Unauthorized retrieved-document disclosure
attack-rag-disclosure.summary: Reveal content the requesting principal should not be authorized to retrieve or view.
attack-rag-disclosure.caveat: A missing access check is an application authorization failure, not necessarily training-data memorization.

attack-rag-poison.title: RAG knowledge-base poisoning
attack-rag-poison.summary: Insert or modify retrieved evidence to steer generated answers or decisions.
attack-rag-poison.caveat: Knowledge corruption is not necessarily an instruction-bearing prompt injection.

attack-refusal-ablation.title: Adversarial refusal-direction modification
attack-refusal-ablation.summary: Apply a refusal-related intervention to bypass a studied model constraint.
attack-refusal-ablation.caveat: Weight-edit variants may also need activation measurement and calibration; other safeguards may remain.

observations.claim: Reported refusal-related directions and interventions in the paper's evaluated models.
observations.limitations: No claim of universal or complete safety removal; model list and revisions must be verified before model-specific badges.

attack-retrieval-rank.title: Retrieval and ranking manipulation
attack-retrieval-rank.summary: Influence which attacker-controlled material is selected as evidence.
attack-retrieval-rank.caveat: Search discoverability, ranking and actual answer influence must be measured independently.

attack-safety-finetune.title: Adversarial fine-tuning to alter constraints
attack-safety-finetune.summary: Use training control to modify a model's refusal or other behavioral properties.
attack-safety-finetune.caveat: Benign fine-tuning can also cause regressions; malicious intent and accidental regression are distinct labels.

attack-session-leak.title: Cross-session or cross-tenant disclosure
attack-session-leak.summary: Expose another principal's data through state, context assembly, caching or access-control failures.
attack-session-leak.caveat: Separate actual content leakage from a timing signal that only suggests prior use.

attack-sft-poison.title: Instruction-tuning data poisoning
attack-sft-poison.summary: Corrupt demonstrations or labels used during supervised adaptation.
attack-sft-poison.caveat: A data-contribution threat differs from complete control of a fine-tuning job.

attack-sleeper.title: Persistent conditional LLM backdoors
attack-sleeper.summary: Study intentionally implanted conditional behavior that can survive tested safety-training procedures.
attack-sleeper.caveat: Not evidence of spontaneous deception or universal resistance to every defense.

attack-sponge.title: Energy and latency amplification / sponge inputs
attack-sponge.summary: Construct expensive inputs for particular model and execution configurations.
attack-sponge.caveat: Hardware and implementation assumptions limit transfer.

attack-steering-misuse.title: Adversarial activation steering
attack-steering-misuse.summary: Use runtime intervention to influence behavior without changing stored weights.
attack-steering-misuse.caveat: Needs the identified intervention surface and evaluation; steering is not always malicious.

attack-token-exhaustion.title: Token, context and inference-budget exhaustion
attack-token-exhaustion.summary: Cause excessive permitted work through input/output length or uncontrolled request behavior.
attack-token-exhaustion.caveat: Separate bounded expensive requests from sustained denial of service and per-tenant quota failure.

attack-tool-description.title: Tool-description poisoning
attack-tool-description.summary: Influence tool selection or actions through attacker-controlled tool metadata.
attack-tool-description.caveat: Client trust behavior and descriptor availability determine exposure.

attack-tool-output.title: Tool-output injection
attack-tool-output.summary: Return lower-trust instructions in a tool response to redirect an agent.
attack-tool-output.caveat: Tool execution success is not equivalent to authority for the response's instructions.

attack-tool-rugpull.title: Tool definition or behavior changes after approval
attack-tool-rugpull.summary: Change a tool after it has acquired user or client trust.
attack-tool-rugpull.caveat: Record version and approval-binding assumptions; metadata changes alone do not prove exploitation.

attack-training-extraction.title: Language-model training-data extraction
attack-training-extraction.summary: Recover training-specific text through model interaction in a setting that permits verification.
attack-training-extraction.caveat: Verbatim-looking output is not proof of membership without a verification method; some procedures use scoring signals.

observations.claim: Reported recovery of training-specific verbatim text in the studied model.
observations.limitations: Architecture and model identity only; exact checkpoint hashes and experiment-level access must be added from full text.

attack-transfer-prompts.title: Transfer of adversarial prompts
attack-transfer-prompts.summary: Apply an attack constructed on a source model to a different target.
attack-transfer-prompts.caveat: Receiving a precomputed suffix is different from having optimized it using only the target API.

attack-unsafe-load.title: Unsafe checkpoint deserialization
attack-unsafe-load.summary: A loader executes or interprets malicious artifact content during model loading.
attack-unsafe-load.caveat: Do not conflate parser/code-execution risk with a learned backdoor.

attack-visual-jailbreak.title: Optimized visual jailbreaks
attack-visual-jailbreak.summary: Use adversarial visual perturbations to affect a vision-language model's safety behavior.
attack-visual-jailbreak.caveat: Distinct from simply placing readable instructions inside an image.

attack-weight-theft.title: Unauthorized checkpoint or adapter theft
attack-weight-theft.summary: Acquire exact artifacts through storage, account or supply-chain compromise.
attack-weight-theft.caveat: Ordinary download of intentionally public weights is not theft.

concept-adjacency.title: Architectural applicability versus empirical evidence
concept-adjacency.summary: A compatible surface is not an experimental demonstration of attack effectiveness.

concept-attention.title: Attention and cross-attention
concept-attention.summary: Attention mechanisms combine representations; cross-attention introduces distinct conditioning surfaces.

concept-boundaries.title: Trust boundaries and authorization
concept-boundaries.summary: Track where data, instructions and authority cross from one principal or component to another.

concept-conditioning.title: Text, image and control conditioning
concept-conditioning.summary: Conditioning can enter through text encoders, cross-attention or additional control branches.

concept-context.title: Context windows and in-context learning
concept-context.summary: Information in the current context is different from information encoded in persistent weights.

concept-decoding.title: Sampling and decoding configuration
concept-decoding.summary: Temperature, selection rules and stopping conditions affect generated outputs without retraining.

concept-embeddings.title: Input and output embeddings
concept-embeddings.summary: Token or modality representations differ from a vector database entry and from output projection weights.

concept-gradients.title: Losses, gradients and optimization
concept-gradients.summary: Training signals and their visibility matter for optimization attacks and privacy leakage.

concept-guidance.title: Classifier-free guidance
concept-guidance.summary: A generative guidance mechanism, not a safety-policy classifier.

concept-kv-cache.title: KV caches and prefix reuse
concept-kv-cache.summary: Inference-state caching can create isolation and timing considerations depending on implementation.

concept-latents.title: Latent spaces and codecs
concept-latents.summary: Latent representations, encoders and decoders contribute separate generative-system surfaces.

concept-logits.title: Logits, probabilities and observable outputs
concept-logits.summary: API output granularity changes what an attacker can infer or optimize.

concept-memorization.title: Memorization, generalization and duplication
concept-memorization.summary: Retaining training-specific information is distinct from merely learning a distribution.

concept-noise.title: Noise schedules and denoising objectives
concept-noise.summary: Noise parameterization and time steps distinguish diffusion-specific interventions.

concept-parameters.title: Weights, parameters and activations
concept-parameters.summary: Distinguish persistent learned tensors from input-dependent intermediate activations.

concept-residual.title: Residual streams and block structure
concept-residual.summary: Shared representation pathways are relevant to localized activation and weight interventions.

concept-samplers.title: Diffusion and flow samplers
concept-samplers.summary: Inference schedules and solvers affect cost and outcomes independently of weights.

concept-tokens.title: Tokenization and vocabulary
concept-tokens.summary: Text segmentation and special tokens are part of the model input contract.

concept-transfer.title: Attack transferability
concept-transfer.summary: Success on one model or configuration does not establish success on a different target.

defense-approval.title: Risk-based human approval
defense-approval.summary: Require informed approval for high-impact actions without presenting approval as a universal protection.

defense-authorization.title: Enforce authorization outside the model
defense-authorization.summary: Check the requesting principal, resource and action in deterministic application code.

defense-backdoor-audit.title: Backdoor-oriented artifact evaluation
defense-backdoor-audit.summary: Test conditional behavior and clean utility; absence of a found trigger is not a proof of absence.

defense-boundaries.title: Separate data from authority
defense-boundaries.summary: Keep lower-trust content from granting itself privileges; defense in depth, not a perfect prompt-only filter.

defense-budget.title: Request, token, tool and cost budgets
defense-budget.summary: Enforce per-principal limits and wall-clock or recursion boundaries outside model discretion.

defense-cache-isolation.title: Cache and session isolation
defense-cache-isolation.summary: Partition reusable state and measure information-sharing signals under realistic conditions.

defense-ci.title: Least-privilege contribution and CI pipeline
defense-ci.summary: Separate untrusted content inspection from credentials, deployment and executable builds.

defense-data-hygiene.title: Training-data minimization and deduplication
defense-data-hygiene.summary: Reduce unnecessary sensitive or repeated records; does not provide a formal privacy guarantee.

defense-disclosure.title: Responsible disclosure and safe research
defense-disclosure.summary: Use authorized test environments, minimize sensitive data, and preserve correction and retraction workflows.

defense-dp.title: Differentially private training
defense-dp.summary: Bound training contribution under a stated privacy definition and accounting procedure.

defense-isolation.title: Sandboxing, egress and execution isolation
defense-isolation.summary: Limit what compromised model-adjacent code or agents can execute and reach.

defense-least-privilege.title: Least-privilege tools and scoped credentials
defense-least-privilege.summary: Limit reachable actions and data; approval must bind to actual arguments and destinations.

defense-logging.title: Auditable action and content lineage
defense-logging.summary: Capture privacy-conscious provenance and tool decisions for investigation, not hidden reasoning extraction.

defense-memory.title: Memory provenance, review and expiry
defense-memory.summary: Record who introduced persistent state and allow scoped review, revocation and reset.

defense-output.title: Context-specific output validation
defense-output.summary: Treat generated code, markup and queries as untrusted input at their final sink.

defense-provenance.title: Dataset and artifact provenance
defense-provenance.summary: Record identities, immutable revisions, transformations and approval history.

defense-rag-acl.title: Authorization-aware retrieval
defense-rag-acl.summary: Filter by principal before disclosure and preserve access metadata through retrieval and generation.

defense-regression.title: Safety and utility regression testing
defense-regression.summary: Reevaluate changed checkpoints, adapters, merges and configurations on held-out tests.

defense-robust-train.title: Adversarial training and robustness evaluation
defense-robust-train.summary: Evaluate against an explicit perturbation set and adaptive attacks.

defense-safe-load.title: Safer tensor loading and dependency control
defense-safe-load.summary: Prefer constrained serialization and audited loaders while retaining parser and behavioral checks.

eval-adaptive.title: Adaptive defense evaluation
eval-adaptive.summary: Evaluate against an attacker who knows the defense rather than only stale fixed prompts.

eval-agentdojo.title: AgentDojo benchmark
eval-agentdojo.summary: A source-specific agent task and prompt-injection evaluation reference.

eval-asr.title: Attack success and severity
eval-asr.summary: Define a measurable success event; distinguish model text from a consequential tool action.

eval-cost.title: Query, token, latency and compute cost
eval-cost.summary: Report budgets and resource impact with the exact experimental configuration.

eval-evidence.title: Claim strength and verification depth
eval-evidence.summary: Separate theory, empirical reporting, independent reproduction, deployment reports and editorial hypotheses.

eval-fidelity.title: Extraction fidelity versus artifact equality
eval-fidelity.summary: Compare functional agreement, task quality and parameter recovery without conflating them.

eval-harmbench.title: HarmBench benchmark
eval-harmbench.summary: A source-specific red-team and robust refusal evaluation reference.

eval-privacy.title: Privacy verification and baselines
eval-privacy.summary: Use membership baselines, record verification, confidence and task-appropriate similarity criteria.

eval-repro.title: Reproducibility and statistical uncertainty
eval-repro.summary: Store seeds, versions, sampling rules, test split and confidence intervals where meaningful.

eval-threat-model.title: Explicit threat model
eval-threat-model.summary: State goals, capabilities, prior knowledge, budgets, authority and target revisions.

eval-transfer.title: Transfer and architecture boundaries
eval-transfer.summary: Distinguish source-model success, target-model transfer, adaptation and unsupported generalization.

eval-utility.title: Clean utility and false positives
eval-utility.summary: Measure normal task completion and overblocking alongside attacks.

family-agent.title: Agent authority and workflow attacks
family-agent.summary: Redirect tool use, memory or inter-agent workflows across trust boundaries.

family-availability.title: Availability and cost attacks
family-availability.summary: Exploit resource allocation, input cost or uncontrolled loops.

family-evaluation.title: Evaluation and accountability attacks
family-evaluation.summary: Distort measurement or evade a specific oversight control.

family-evasion.title: Adversarial input evasion
family-evasion.summary: Perturb inputs or their presentation to change predictions or guardrail decisions.

family-misuse.title: Capability misuse
family-misuse.summary: Use a legitimate model capability for harmful activity without assuming model compromise.

family-poisoning.title: Poisoning, backdoors and persistence
family-poisoning.summary: Corrupt inputs to learning or persistent state to influence later behavior.

family-privacy.title: Privacy inference and data extraction
family-privacy.summary: Infer or reconstruct protected data under different visibility assumptions.

family-prompt.title: Prompt and context manipulation
family-prompt.summary: Attacks that reinterpret or override instructions through model-visible inputs.

family-representation.title: Representation and weight interventions
family-representation.summary: White-box model modifications and runtime interventions applied adversarially.

family-retrieval.title: Retrieval and knowledge manipulation
family-retrieval.summary: Influence external evidence, selection, authorization or attribution.

family-supply.title: Supply-chain and runtime compromise
family-supply.summary: Compromise loaders, artifacts, dependencies or hosting components.

family-theft.title: Model artifact theft and functional extraction
family-theft.summary: Acquire artifacts or reproduce behavior with distinct threat models.

family-training.title: Training and adaptation abuse
family-training.summary: Attacker-influenced data, objectives or updates can change model behavior.

format-engine.title: Compiled inference engines
format-engine.summary: Executable optimized plans, distinct from data-only weight containers.

format-gguf.title: GGUF
format-gguf.summary: Binary tensor/metadata packaging; can store different numerical types and supported architectures.

format-model-package.title: Complete model package
format-model-package.summary: Weights alone are insufficient: tokenizer, config, templates, revisions and auxiliary modules affect behavior.

format-onnx.title: ONNX
format-onnx.summary: Interchange representation with computational graphs, operators and parameters.

format-pytorch.title: PyTorch checkpoints and pickle-related loading
format-pytorch.summary: Checkpoint extensions do not fully describe loading behavior or executable deserialization risk.

format-safetensors.title: Safetensors
format-safetensors.summary: Tensor serialization with a safer loading design; does not establish benign learned behavior.

goal-actions.title: Cause unauthorized actions or privilege use
goal-actions.summary: Redirect an agent or application into unauthorized tool calls, data access or changes.

goal-availability.title: Degrade availability or increase cost
goal-availability.summary: Exhaust capacity, latency, energy, tokens or tool budgets; distinguish algorithmic effects from generic request floods.

goal-behavior.title: Violate intended behavioral constraints
goal-behavior.summary: Cause the system to produce behavior its operator intends to disallow; includes safeguard bypass but not all output errors.

goal-decisions.title: Manipulate outputs, predictions or decisions
goal-decisions.summary: Change a task result, ranking, generated artifact or downstream decision in the attacker's favor.

goal-environment.title: Compromise the surrounding execution environment
goal-environment.summary: Exploit loaders, packages, plugins, build systems or integrations to compromise the host or distribution channel.

goal-evasion.title: Evade security controls or accountability
goal-evasion.summary: Defeat a deployed detector, monitoring or attribution control; metric-specific, not identical to refusal bypass.

goal-information.title: Obtain protected information
goal-information.summary: Infer or disclose training examples, attributes, prompts, retrieved records, session data or secrets without authorization.

goal-misuse.title: Use AI to amplify harmful activity
goal-misuse.summary: Adjacent misuse lens: abuse a capability without necessarily compromising the model or its host.

goal-model-theft.title: Appropriate model artifacts or capabilities
goal-model-theft.summary: Acquire weights, adapters or functional imitation; separate exact artifact theft from behavioral replication.

goal-persistence.title: Establish persistent attacker influence
goal-persistence.summary: Make attacker-selected behavior survive future sessions, triggers, updates or ordinary retraining.

life-continued.title: Continued pretraining
life-continued.summary: Further training on a continued or domain-specific objective; not necessarily instruction tuning.

life-data.title: Data collection, filtering and deduplication
life-data.summary: Dataset lineage and preprocessing affect privacy, integrity and evaluation reliability.

life-deploy.title: Deployment, monitoring and updates
life-deploy.summary: Packaging, serving and integration change security exposure beyond the model checkpoint.

life-dpo.title: Direct Preference Optimization
life-dpo.summary: A preference-learning objective; distinguish standard DPO from reward-model-plus-PPO training.

life-evaluate.title: Evaluation data and benchmark governance
life-evaluate.summary: Separate training, attack development, validation and final testing.

life-posttrain.title: Post-training
life-posttrain.summary: Umbrella for adaptation after pretraining, including but not limited to alignment.

life-preferences.title: Preference data and reward models
life-preferences.summary: Human or synthetic comparisons can influence post-training objectives.

life-pretrain.title: Pretraining
life-pretrain.summary: Initial broad learning from a training objective and corpus.

life-rlhf.title: RLHF and policy optimization
life-rlhf.summary: Learning from feedback may involve a reward model and policy optimization; not the only alignment route.

life-safety.title: Safety and instruction tuning
life-safety.summary: Intended behavioral constraints are learned properties that need evaluation after modifications.

life-sft.title: Supervised fine-tuning
life-sft.summary: Optimize on labeled demonstrations or input-output examples.

system-agent.title: Tool-using agents
system-agent.summary: A loop combines model decisions, tools, observations and policy enforcement.

system-browser.title: Browser and computer-use integrations
system-browser.summary: Rendered pages and document content can become model observations and trigger actions.

system-eval.title: Evaluation pipelines and automated judges
system-eval.summary: Judges, test sets and grading code are security-relevant dependencies.

system-index.title: Corpora, vector indexes and rerankers
system-index.summary: Chunking, embeddings and ranking influence which external content reaches a model.

system-loader.title: Model loaders and executable repository code
system-loader.summary: Parsing or importing model artifacts is a separate host-execution trust decision.

system-memory.title: Persistent agent memory
system-memory.summary: Stored summaries, preferences or instructions can influence later sessions.

system-multiagent.title: Multi-agent orchestration
system-multiagent.summary: Messages and delegated authority cross multiple component boundaries.

system-rag.title: Retrieval-augmented generation
system-rag.summary: Retrieval, ranking, authorization, prompt assembly and generation are separate components.

system-registry.title: Model registries and distribution
system-registry.summary: Artifacts, revisions, licenses and upstream dependencies need provenance.

system-serving.title: Inference engines and serving gateways
system-serving.summary: Batching, caches, request isolation and scheduling are runtime properties.

system-tools.title: Tools, plugins, MCP and connectors
system-tools.summary: Descriptions, arguments, outputs, identity and authorization are distinct tool surfaces.

tool-diffusers.title: Hugging Face Diffusers
tool-diffusers.summary: Composable generative pipelines and scheduler tooling.

tool-llamacpp.title: llama.cpp
tool-llamacpp.summary: Inference runtime commonly associated with GGUF artifacts.

tool-mlx.title: MLX
tool-mlx.summary: Array and ML framework often used in Apple-silicon environments.

tool-tensorrt.title: TensorRT / TensorRT-adjacent serving
tool-tensorrt.summary: Optimization and execution ecosystem requiring explicit engine and plugin trust.

tool-transformers.title: Hugging Face Transformers
tool-transformers.summary: Model training/inference library; separate from transformer architecture.

tool-unsloth.title: Unsloth
tool-unsloth.summary: Efficiency-oriented model tooling; not pretraining, post-training, architecture or file format.

tool-vllm.title: vLLM
tool-vllm.summary: Serving runtime with version-dependent scheduling and caching behavior.

transform-conversion.title: Checkpoint conversion and sharding
transform-conversion.summary: Repackage representations and metadata; compatibility and integrity are separate questions.

transform-gptq.title: GPTQ
transform-gptq.summary: A specific post-training weight-quantization method, not a general model family.

transform-merging.title: Model and adapter merging
transform-merging.summary: Combine compatible parameters or updates; provenance and behavioral regressions must be reassessed.

transform-pruning.title: Pruning and sparsity
transform-pruning.summary: Remove or constrain parameters/connections; security effects are not guaranteed by compression.

transform-quantization.title: Quantization and numerical precision
transform-quantization.summary: Change numerical representation, often with calibration; separate from serialization and training stage.

A01.title: Output-query access
A01.caveat: No weights, logits, training data or privileged context are implied.

A02.title: Score or logit API access
A02.caveat: Specify score precision, top-k restrictions and any allowed logit transformations.

A03.title: White-box or surrogate optimization
A03.caveat: A surrogate and target must be separately identified; transfer is not guaranteed.

A04.title: External-context authoring
A04.caveat: Victim must actually ingest the lower-trust content; attacker does not control system instructions.

A05.title: Retrieval-corpus contribution
A05.caveat: Insertion, ranking and ingestion permissions vary; corpus write does not imply tool authority.

A06.title: Tool metadata or response influence
A06.caveat: Registration, version changes and output control are distinct subvariants.

A07.title: Activation intervention
A07.caveat: Requires compatible runtime hooks; ordinary API prompting is insufficient.

A08.title: Readable model artifacts
A08.caveat: Weights, adapters or configurations are readable; distinguish public access from unauthorized access.

A09.title: Writable or replaceable model artifacts
A09.caveat: Use separate calibration/runtime-read capabilities where the method requires them.

A10.title: Training-data contribution
A10.caveat: Data must enter an actual training run; ingestion and effective influence are additional conditions.

A11.title: Training or fine-tuning control
A11.caveat: Specify trainable tensors, data, objective, compute and restrictions of a hosted service.

A12.title: Agent-exposed capability
A12.caveat: Success additionally depends on delegated tools, policy enforcement and reachable resources.

A13.title: Dependency or package distribution
A13.caveat: Victim must install, import or execute the affected artifact.

A14.title: Observable shared-service timing
A14.caveat: Shared state, noise, isolation and repeatable signal must be established.

A15.title: Candidate records and auxiliary knowledge
A15.caveat: Membership/attribute methods need baselines; extra scores or shadow data are variant-specific.

A16.title: Shared gradients or updates
A16.caveat: Not an ordinary text-only API setting; batching and defenses change feasibility.

A17.title: Persistent-memory influence
A17.caveat: Attacker-controlled content must persist and be used in later decisions.

A18.title: Image/audio/video input influence
A18.caveat: Perturbation limits and modality preprocessing are part of the threat model.

A19.title: Inference configuration control
A19.caveat: Sampling settings, system prompts and model weights are distinct privileges.

A20.title: Evaluation or feedback influence
A20.caveat: Judge prompts, benchmark data, labels and reward signals are separate subvariants.

A21.title: Model-output reaches an unsafe sink
A21.caveat: An application must consume output as code, markup, queries or another privileged form.
